text:
marta.partner: Heads-up: Partner 'Helios' POC next Wed. Need quick checklist + one-pager on entitlements, SLA, and BYOK expectations.

ben.sales: I'll handle pricing and SLA. They expect steady 100 rps, bursts to 400 for 10min. Want a burst credit model.

ryan.eng: Can provision staging in eu-central. Need SAML metadata and partner CIDRs. Also confirm whether they require active-active failover or just passive.

katie.solutions: I'll draft runbook with sections: tenant provisioning, SSO exchange, entitlement->token mapping, warmup, fallback policy, and alert hooks.

leo.security: Security asks: BYOK (hosted?), log retention, and RTO/RPO. Hosted BYOK is not GA; Private supports HSM. I'll mark BYOK as product/legal dependency.

marta.partner: They also want a pre-demo smoke test: run 50 example prompts and share latency + token cost. Can we automate that?

ryan.eng: Yes. I'll add a simple warmup script and a smoke test harness. Example curl loop: for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TK" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"smoke"}' & done

deploy-bot: tenant-provisioner queued: helios-staging -> eta ~5m.

ben.sales: Uploaded draft quote to SFDC opp/11456. Also added clause about burst credits.

leo.security: Sending draft questionnaire answers: encryption AES-256 at rest, TLS v1.2+, SOC2 attestation link, audit retention options 30/90/365.

katie.solutions: I'll post the runbook doc link after tenant is ready and include alert expressions for token burn and quality regression.

marta.partner: Great. Timeline: runbook + tenant up in 24h, security answers in 12h, sales to finalize quote. Ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup:
